source_snapshot.procedure: Collect `mst status -v`, physically loop back all MLNX ports and inspect InfiniBand physical state with ibstat.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; substitutes first-interface ethtool/mlxlink reads, truncates output and omits physical loopback and all-port ibstat.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Require complete port mapping/personality, controlled loopback, workload isolation, OOB recovery and untruncated per-port evidence.

old_problem: The all-port physical loopback had no serial/BDF/MST/netdev/IB-port map, port personality, fixture/cable plan, isolation, expected physical/logical states or restoration. DeepSeek tested only the first discovered interface and did not perform the physical action or source ibstat coverage.
disposition_reason: The source purpose and physical method are explicit. ED-03 permits port maps, fixture and expected states as project configuration, ED-05 requires InfiniBand and Ethernet paths to remain distinct, and ED-09 keeps cable/loopback handling manual while the complete MST/ibstat evidence remains automatable. Each port identity and coverage is retained under ED-19.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row389 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history2981 and unique variant.
Separated InfiniBand `ibstat` physical/logical state from Ethernet ethtool semantics: an Ethernet-personality port cannot be credited by an IB result or silently omitted.
Retained `mst status -v`, physical loopback of every approved MLNX port, complete per-port state, 10-minute allocations and restoration; first-device/truncated evidence is rejected.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row390 and verified its manifest identity; no cable move, loopback, link command or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: All mapped MLNX InfiniBand ports physical-loopback and MST/ibstat conformance
test_case.purpose: Verify every approved MLNX port is correctly represented in MST and, when configured for InfiniBand, reaches the signed physical/logical state under its controlled physical loopback fixture and returns to its original topology afterward.
required_package: Signed per-port personality and scope: InfiniBand ports for this ibstat case; Ethernet ports tracked as separate Ethernet coverage
Approved loopback cable/fixture, connector/port pairing, installation/removal sequence and operator
Expected MST inventory and per-IB-port Physical state, State, rate, width, LID/GUID and allowed counter/transient rules
Maintenance isolation, alternate OOB path, workload drain, link/error monitoring and restoration/recovery
test_case.test_command: After mapping, personality, fixture and isolation approval, preserve logs and full `mst status -v`; a qualified operator installs the approved loopback on one mapped port/pair at a time; retain complete unfiltered `ibstat` for every in-scope InfiniBand device/port and optional approved mlxlink evidence, correlate it to the physical fixture, remove the loopback and prove the original cabling, links and traffic are restored before advancing.
test_case.expected_result: Every mapped in-scope MLNX device/port is present in MST; each InfiniBand loopback reaches the signed Physical/State/rate/width and identity values without disallowed errors; no Ethernet port is judged from ibstat; fixture identity is documented and every port returns to its original approved link/traffic state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is per physical connector and software port and requires the complete mapping, operator fixture record, full MST/ibstat output, signed state/rate rules and restoration. First-device data, a port-name grep, an Ethernet result substituted for IB or missing port cannot pass.
safety_gate: Qualified operator handles each approved cable/fixture; do not loop back unmapped, production or sole-management ports
Drain/isolate InfiniBand workloads and maintain independent OOB before any physical change
Preserve link/AER/system evidence and observe every port without truncated output
Stop on wrong connector, unexpected traffic, link flap/error, PCIe/thermal/power anomaly or failed restoration; no automatic retry
expected_evidence: Complete adapter/software/physical-port map with signed IB-versus-Ethernet scope
Before/after full MST inventory and original link/traffic state
Timestamped operator/fixture/connector evidence for every in-scope port
Complete per-device/port ibstat and approved optional mlxlink output with state/rate comparison
Restored cabling/link/traffic proof and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On unexpected link or management loss, stop physical changes, preserve evidence, use alternate OOB, return only the currently affected connector to its signed original cabling, verify port/traffic recovery and quarantine any port that cannot regain its approved state. Never change personality or reset/retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The Master all-port physical loopback plus MST/ibstat scope remains authoritative; DeepSeek's first-device ethtool/mlxlink substitution is rejected, yielding one coherent hybrid manual/automated testcase.

blocked.reason: Physical method, observation layers, evidence and recovery are defined; exact map/fixture/states are execution prerequisites.
